aboutLong: I'm a Systems Engineering student at Universidad El Bosque in Bogotá and a junior fullstack developer. I like turning ideas into digital solutions that work and look good. I've built Java applications using the MVC pattern, worked on a team with Scrum, Jira, Confluence and SonarCloud to build an accommodation marketplace, and made my first game prototype in Unity during a diploma in video game design and development.
